sections.label: TraceTogether token distribution to seniors
sections.summary: Asked whether tokens reached all seniors and how citizens without smartphones can access cinemas; distribution started in areas with more elderly residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister (a) whether the TraceTogether tokens have been distributed to all seniors; and (b) how does the Smart Nation and Digital Government Office ensure that citizens without smart phones and who have not been able to collect the TraceTogether token are able to access cinemas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: We started distribution in areas with a higher proportion of elderly residents, such as Tanjong Pagar and Jalan Besar.

sections.label: Token collection at Community Centres
sections.summary: Residents of Jalan Besar, Tanjong Pagar, Bishan-Toa Payoh, Sengkang, Ang Mo Kio, Marsiling, Fuchun and Woodgrove could collect a TT token at their Community Centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: By now, residents of Jalan Besar, Tanjong Pagar, Bishan-Toa Payoh, Sengkang, Ang Mo Kio, Marsiling, Fuchun and Woodgrove would also have been able to collect a TT token at their Community Centres or CCs.

sections.label: Pop-up booths in malls
sections.summary: Pop-up booths were set up in malls such as Clementi Mall, where 762 tokens were distributed on 25 October.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Hence, we had this plan to set up these pop-up booths in malls such as Clementi Mall.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We distributed 762 tokens at Clementi Mall on 25 October.

sections.label: CCs distribute to local residents
sections.summary: Because people travelled from all around Singapore to collect tokens, the distribution plan was altered so CCs distribute tokens only to residents of that area.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We had also planned for residents to pick up tokens from the CCs near them and we had not anticipated the extent to which people from all around Singapore would go to a various venues in order to collect the TraceTogether token.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Hence, we have altered our distribution plan so that CCs are distributing tokens only to residents of that area.

sections.label: Roll-out before compulsory SafeEntry
sections.summary: The roll-out plan with distribution to the various CCs will happen before the TraceTogether-only SafeEntry programme is made compulsory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Perhaps Senior Minister of State can clarify that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will make sure that the roll-out plan with distribution to the various CCs has happened before the TraceTogether-only SafeEntry programme is made compulsory.

sections.label: Other SafeEntry means available
sections.summary: Until distribution is completed, other means of doing SafeEntry such as using NRIC will be available, with a plan for damaged tokens and exhausted batteries.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Until the distribution is completed, other means of doing SafeEntry, such as using your NRIC will be available at these venues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will have a clear plan for replacement of damaged tokens or changing out the batteries for those batteries that are exhausted.

sections.label: Token exchange and compulsory use
sections.summary: Residents with damaged or depleted tokens can exchange them at CCs, and compulsory use will wait until token distribution is completed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In the mean time, residents with damaged tokens or tokens with depleted batteries can go to CCs where tokens are being distributed to exchange it for another.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will leverage on those types of processes and those types of partnerships to make sure this capability then continues to be available for Singaporeans in the future.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we will wait until after token distribution is completed before making it compulsory.

sections.label: Token distribution in schools
sections.summary: The government will work with MOE to see what is feasible or necessary for distributing tokens in schools.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: On the issue of the distribution of tokens in the schools, we will work with MOE and see what is feasible or necessary.

sections.label: Equitable distribution and public education
sections.summary: Focus is on an equitable distribution plan across Singapore, and further public education is needed to reduce misinformation about the TraceTogether app.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We may have to look at the best possible options.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I think our focus at the moment is making sure that we have an equitable distribution plan across Singapore, to address the concerns such as articulated by Mr Lim, that we have to do so in order to then allow the implementation of these TraceTogether-only SafeEntry areas to deal with high risk activities as part of that progress.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I agree with him that further public education is needed and so we have to make sure that we reduce misinformation or disinformation about what the TraceTogether app is and does and what the programme is for.
